Hi Anna — thanks for the note and the dataset, that helps. Quick answers up front:

- Yes, we can support bifurcated VPCs under a single customer account and keep isolated control planes for analytics vs clinical — requires scoped network ranges and a short provisioning window.
- We can reserve a burst pool for edge clusters; options are (i) committed burst units (monthly credit toward peak), or (ii) reserved dedicated nodes (hard reservation). Both can be reflected in the amendment.
- 24‑month term is doable and we can offer a stepped discount tied to committed monthly units.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa will send a pricing/term summary and a draft amendment for legal/PO.
2) Dev will validate the provisioning plan and lead times, and list pre-reqs (IP ranges, KMS, firewall rules).
3) Set a technical call this week to confirm cluster sizing and go/no-go so we can hit your 11/15 procurement date.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (contracts/pricing) and Dev (infra ops). If that plan works, Marissa will follow with a preliminary cost schedule by EOD tomorrow.

— Karthik

Hi all,

Technical notes and constraints for the bifurcated VPC + edge clusters:

1) Feasibility: Fully supported. We will provision separate control-plane clusters per VPC and route inference traffic with smart routing policies.
2) Lead times: Dedicated node provisioning + network setup for each new edge cluster = ~3–4 weeks from receipt of IP blocks and KMS details. If you choose Option A (reserved nodes), add 1 week for capacity reservation and scheduling.
3) Staged rollout: We can phase clusters — spin up one edge cluster first (smoke tests), then the second to reduce risk.
4) Pre-reqs for procurement/ops team to provide:
   - CIDR ranges for both VPCs,
   - KMS key ARN and admin contact,
   - List of firewall egress/inbound rules (we will provide a template),
   - Contact for on-call during provisioning (weekends possible for coordinated cutovers).

I attached a cluster_sizing_estimate.xlsx with a node-by-node estimate and warm/cold-cache assumptions. If they need lower-cost SKUs, we can propose a mixed-quantized profile but that will require additional evals on sample prompts.

— Dev
